model_message.content: Both ends have valid, differing Areas (r1: 0.0.0.1, r2: 0.0.0.0) on the interconnect, and no neighbors form. This is a confirmed OSPF area mismatch.

Both ends have valid but different Areas on the interconnect (r1 eth1 = area 0.0.0.1, r2 eth1 = area 0.0.0.0), interfaces are up (not admin down), no passive on the interconnect, and no OSPF routes/neighbors — a confirmed area mismatch.
